items.title: Empire State Building Lit Up with Gold Marks Historic Milestone of NASA's Voyager 1
lines: Did you see Voyager 1 is now one light day away from Earth?
One light day? That's wild. It launched in the seventies, right?
Yep. They lit the Empire State Building gold for it.

items.title: Crows can make decisions twice as fast as humans, scientists discover
lines: Apparently crows make decisions twice as fast as we do.
Faster than me picking lunch, for sure.

items.title: This Blue Whale Population Grew 1,000% Since the End of Antarctic Whaling
lines: I just read a blue whale population grew 1,000 percent.
Since Antarctic whaling ended. Good news for once!
